title: Engram Injection: A Study of Temporal Validity in Parametric Language-Model Memory
abstract: arXiv:2610.15882v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A stored fact may stop being valid when a user changes a preference or an event replaces an earlier one. We study whether a language model can learn these changes in its parameters and answer correctly from only a question and the current time. Engram Injection stores facts in LoRA adapters and supplies the clock through FiLM conditioning on a frozen Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct model. We compare it with additive clock conditioning, prompting with the full dated history, and retrieving four dated records. We train six matched adapters across three seeds after fixing a sampler that could admit test-age examples into training. The training audit reports no such examples among 127,760 evaluated training inputs. On 62 pairs of questions asked before and after an update, at an elapsed age of seven days excluded from training, both adapter methods answer zero pairs correctly under the primary blinded assistant review with order code 1 held fixed. translated_title: 印记注入：参数化语言模型记忆中的时间有效性研究
translated_abstract: 当用户更改偏好或某个事件取代先前的事件时，已存储的事实可能会失效。我们研究语言模型能否在其参数中学习这些变化，并仅凭问题和当前时间正确作答。Engram Injection（印记注入）将事实存储在LoRA适配器中，并通过FiLM条件化在冻结的Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct模型上提供时钟信息。我们将其与加性时钟条件化、基于完整带日期历史记录的提示方法以及检索四条带日期记录的方法进行比较。在修复了一个可能将测试时间样本混入训练的采样器之后，我们在三个随机种子上训练了六个匹配的适配器。训练审计报告显示，在评估的127,760个训练输入中不存在此类样本。在更新前后提出的62对问题上，在训练中被排除的七天经过时间下，在保持顺序代码1固定的主要盲评助手审查中，两种适配器方法对全部62对问题均未能正确回答。
tldr: 本文提出Engram Injection方法，将事实存储于LoRA适配器并通过FiLM条件化向冻结的语言模型注入时间信息，但严格排除测试时间样本的评估显示，该参数化记忆方法在事实更新后无法正确回答任何时间敏感问题对，揭示了参数化记忆在处理时间有效性上的局限。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Engram Injection, which stores facts in LoRA adapters with FiLM-based clock conditioning on a frozen Qwen2.5-3B model, but rigorous evaluation excluding test-age examples shows both adapter methods answer zero of 62 pre/post-update question pairs correctly, revealing fundamental limits of parametric memory for temporal fact validity.
